name: Western US MTBS-Interagency (WUMI) wildfire dataset / SMLFire1.0
model_or_instrument: MTBS satellite observations, agency wildfire records, Climgrid, PRISM, UCLA-ERA5, gridMET, NSIDC, NLDN, NLCD, SILVIS, USGS
size_as_stated: all wildfires from the WUMI data set that occurred between 1984-2020 inclusive (fires >= 1 km^2 from agencies, >= 4 km^2 from MTBS); 10000 fire occurrences and absences sampled; 35 fire-related features
resolution: 12 km x 12 km grid; monthly aggregations (1984-2020)

scales.note: WUMI/SMLFire1.0 dataset resampled to a 12 km grid across the Western US (west of 103°W) on monthly intervals from 1984 to 2020 (37 years).
